remarks: Looking for a peaceful neighborhood without sacrificing a prime location? This recently renovated, 1,200-square-foot open-concept condo in Glenbrook gives you the absolute best of Stamford living. This home is located in a serene, tree-lined neighborhood on the Darien border, yet sits just a 10-minute walk from the Glenbrook train station and minutes from Downtown Stamford, I-95, and the Merritt Parkway.  The interior features modern upgrades throughout, including a stylishly refreshed kitchen complete with granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, brand-new kitchen and bathroom flooring, and fresh paint. The thoughtful layout includes a massive primary bedroom that easily accommodates a king-sized bed, featuring double closets and its own private half-bath. A bright second bedroom provides excellent closet space and the ideal quiet environment for guests or a work-from-home setup. Complete with the ultimate conveniences of in-unit laundry, a full bath with a tub-shower combo, and a locked bonus storage unit in the neighboring building, this hidden gem is entirely move-in ready. Schedule your viewing today!
